events.name: Bash
events.head: Check origin, fix ancestry, deployments
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git merge-base --is-ancestor a67da2c origin/main && echo anc-ok; wc -l cloud/src/webinar.ts app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs; grep -n "webinar" cloud/src/index.ts | head; cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list --name revops-centre 2>/dev/null | tail -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe header
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,20p app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs; git status --short cloud/src app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how prior runs started local stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -o 'wrangler dev[^"]\{0,250\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-237.json | tail -3; grep -o 'vendor-sim[^"]\{0,150\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-237.json | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find local stack helper scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E 'sim|stack|local' | head; grep -rl "vendor-sim" app/scripts/*.sh cloud/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -l "SIM_PORT" -r app/scripts scripts 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.text: I'm getting a local stack running so I can re-run the webinar sign-up probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate vendor sim and its usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; find . -name "vendor-sim*.py" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -n "SIM_PORT\|wrangler dev\|--var" app/scripts/probe-kept-tools.mjs | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe setup and dev startup hints
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 20,40p app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs; grep -n "wrangler.*dev\|--var\|persist\|SIM_URL" app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs app/scripts/probe-stack.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: List dev var names and check ports free
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; grep -o '^[A-Z_]*=' .dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '; echo; lsof -ti:8896,8897 | head; grep -n "database_name\|^name" wrangler.toml | head -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check wrangler config and port usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; ls wrangler* ; grep -n '"database_name"\|"name"\|SIM_URL' wrangler.jsonc 2>/dev/null | head -5; curl -s -m2 127.0.0.1:8896 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'; curl -s -m2 127.0.0.1:8897 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start vendor sim and local centre on fresh state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/t237-XXXX); echo $T > /tmp/t237-dir; SIM_PORT=8897 SIM_STATE=$T/sim.json SIM_PUBLIC=http://127.0.0.1:8897 nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > $T/sim.log 2>&1 & echo $! > $T/sim.pid; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to $T/state > $T/mig.log 2>&1; tail -2 $T/mig.log; nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8896 --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to $T/state --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8897 > $T/dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > $T/dev.pid; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -m2 -o /dev/null 127.0.0.1:8896/webinar/register

events.text: Local stack is up; running the webinar sign-up probe now.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run webinar signup probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8896 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8897 node scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs 2>&1 | tail -22
